literal_meaning: চুল (hair) লাফালাফি বা দোলানো (shaking or waving hair playfully)
figurative_meaning_en: to wander around restlessly or playfully
similar_in_english: to flit from place to place
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সারাদিন বাড়ির চারপাশে চুলবুল করে ঘুরে বেড়ায়।
example_sentences_in_english: The children are frolicking in the park.
She wanders restlessly around the house all day.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of light, carefree movement, often used affectionately for playful wandering.
